newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.62 pct vs mark/usd basket.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown +4.62 pct vs mark/usd basket.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 27.922 to the dollar after Tuesday's fixing at 28.017, and at 16.894 to the mark from 16.944.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of the central bank's mark/dollar basket of +4.62 percent, up from Tuesday's +4.32-deviation.
During the minute when the central bank calculated the fixing, the crown was on the interbank market at +4.59 percent.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of the mark/dollar basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
